scripts.preview: node scripts/materialize-agent.mjs && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.deploy: node scripts/materialize-agent.mjs && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy

EVE_AGENT_CONFIG_URL.description: Generated by eve Agent Builder. Paste the copied EVE_AGENT_CONFIG_URL assignment from the builder deployment flow.

AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY.description: Model gateway API key for the generated agent.

BRAINTRUST_API_KEY.description: Braintrust API key when the generated agent enables Braintrust observability.

LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY.description: Langfuse secret key when the generated agent enables Langfuse observability.

LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Langfuse public key when the generated agent enables Langfuse observability.

LANGFUSE_BASE_URL.description: Langfuse API base URL, usually https://cloud.langfuse.com.

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.description: Supabase project URL when the generated agent enables Supabase.

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.description: Supabase anon key when the generated agent enables Supabase.

SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Supabase service role key when the generated agent enables Supabase.

UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL.description: Upstash Redis REST URL when the generated agent enables Upstash.

UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN.description: Upstash Redis REST token when the generated agent enables Upstash.
